name: opencode-image-context
description: Bound base64 image payloads replayed into OpenCode sessions (V1 + V2) while preserving recent visual context.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm && bun build ./src/v1.ts ./src/v2.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external zod
